## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle late-Míng compilation by **Guǎng Mò** 廣莫 ([廣莫](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%A3%E8%8E%AB)) of the *yuánqǐ* (origin-narratives) and *shìyì* (factual explanations) for the *Sìfēn prātimokṣa* rules — that is, the *vibhaṅga*-derived case-narratives explaining the institution of each rule, together with explanatory notes.

**Abstract**

The text assembles practical-pedagogical material on the *Sìfēn prātimokṣa* rules — origin-narratives + explanatory notes — for instructional use. The genre was popular in late-Míng monastic education as it provided the historical-narrative context that mere rule-recitation lacked.
